name: Snowman Hat
desc: Whatever one is feeling at the moment, this hat covers it all up with a happy expression made from coal and carrots.

name: Paladin Harness
desc: A golden breastplate with loose fabric sewn to it that makes you feel like a stealthy warrior of the desert.

name: Cooking Pot Lid
desc: A shiny metal cover that suppresses your boiling point.

name: Cooking Pot Tub
desc: Only the ones really passionate about cooking dare to become the pot itself.

name: Magma Torso Armor
desc: This fiery armor is almost too hot to handle but becomes well-tempered when worn.

name: Paladin Pants
desc: Wide harem pants made for fighting, coupled with a set of pointy golden shoes.

name: Cosmos Torso
desc: This airtight jacket keeps the atmosphere around your body evenly pressured and is equipped with a system to increase damage efficiency.

name: Magma Shin Armor
desc: A melting leg armor made from liquid stone, giving hot legs a whole new definition.

name: Stone Pants
desc: Bulky legwear sculpted from solid rock. The best way to train the calves.

name: Slime Armor
desc: A gelatinous upper body armor that looks like someone dumped a bucket of goo onto you.

name: Galaxite Torso
desc: A futuristic protection for the upper body. Its intimidating yet elegant design is a true marvel to look at.

name: Dracularva Cape
desc: A black satin cape fit for a vampire. The crimson flip-up collar adds to the evil look.

name: Ranger Tunic
desc: A light tunic with a quiver allowing for swift archery.

name: Dreamer Vest
desc: A pair of near weightless jade sashes connected by a gilded ring, flowing in light breeze.

name: Shadow Chestplate
desc: A chestpiece that makes your heart feel hollow.

name: Welder Chestplate
desc: A heat-resistant metal chestpiece filled with of thermoreductive slag wool.

name: Carapace Breastplate
desc: An organic body armor resembling Ghorm's shell, it is heavy and feels weird on the inside.

name: Scarlet Breastplate
desc: Fierce upper body armor for true warriors.

name: Scarab Harness
desc: A masterfully crafted upper body armor to endure the dangers of the desert.

name: Pot Tub
desc: This brittle clay container is just your size and usually filled with caveling supplies.

name: Blast Plackart
desc: A rusty amalgam of plates fit to endure the fiercest demolitions.

name: Copper Breastplate
desc: Got no sixpack? Just craft one!

name: Bronze Breastplate
desc: A good armor to survive battles more easily.

name: Octarine Breastplate
desc: This mysterious breastplate stimulates the muscles to swing your weapon much faster.

name: Core Commander Brigandine
desc: An astonishing upper body armor that sends pulses of energy through the body. It feels almost forbidden to wear it, brimming with more power than a human body could potentially handle.

name: Cosmos Legwear
desc: Heavy pants that are less suited for quick movements and more for safely treading on foreign planets.

name: Paladin Mask
desc: A mysterious piece of equipment with a golden mask. It seems to have been granted to warriors of high rank.

name: Godsent King Breast Armor
desc: A unique, royal piece of armor resembling the heart of the state. Golden wings were added to inherit the grace of Azeos. Before it could be used, the kingdom crumbled to dust from the inside.

name: Wildwarden Pauldrons
desc: This wooden chest-piece is wrapped in a bundle of mysteriously unwithering leaves.

name: Sulfossil Cuirass
desc: This volatile mass latches its plating onto your body. It feels ready to retaliate.

name: Sulfossil Boots
desc: The gel padding adds a bounce to your step. Surprisingly quiet for the force contained within.

name: Blast Pants
desc: A pair of sturdy sabatons impervious to being windswept from shockwaves.

name: Frankenbrute Head
desc: Put more head on your head. Doesn't necessarily add up to more brain, though.

name: Pot Lid
desc: A heavy clay cover that has partially cracked and doubles down as a funny hat.

name: Larva Chest
desc: Don't be anything else. Be grub.

name: Copper Pants
desc: Protects the shins with ease.

name: Solarite Tassets
desc: Heavy hip protection made from miraculous materials. When it is worn, you feel guided along a path to victory.

name: Inventor Leggings
desc: Pants reeking of the strange smells from the countless vials lining its belt.

name: Wood Chest
desc: Very crude armor for the upper body. Offers minor protection.

name: Hivebone Breastplate
desc: A fleshy suit covered by protective spines. The feeling on your skin is quite unpleasant.

name: Moldweb Breastplate
desc: A chest-piece covered in living mold, hungering for big prey.

name: Solarite Cuirass
desc: A crystalline piece of equipment that shields the upper body like a fortress. The bright material evokes old memories of the sun.

name: Hazmat Suit Jacket
desc: Whatever the problem is, encountering it behind a protective suit makes it a little less stressful.

name: Void-Fused Chestpiece
desc: A heavy contraption of a chestpiece consisting of rusty layers welded to a glasslike dark material.

name: Inventor Apron
desc: An apron contaminated with at least five never-before-seen chemical compounds.

name: Iron Pants
desc: You've got knees of steel!

name: Scarlet Pants
desc: March through your enemies and don't look back.

name: Hivebone Pants
desc: Legwear of haphazard pillows of thick hide that wrap around the legs as defensive folds.

name: Moldweb Pants
desc: Legwear covered in living mold. It seems uninterested in feeding on the wearer.

name: Hazmat Suit Pants
desc: A protective suit is not complete without some boots that save the feet.

name: Desert Guardian Pants
desc: Some light fabric over a dark, full-body layer. It's rather tight.

name: Shadow Leggings
desc: A pair of leggings that makes your lower body feel weightless.

name: Welder Leggings
desc: Heat-resistant metal leggings that consist of insulating multilayered fiberglass.

name: Magma Horn Armor
desc: A pretty awesome piece of equipment that makes you look like the harbinger of doom.

name: Pumpkin Head
desc: A fruit head with a carved-in face. For how disgusting it feels from the inside, it looks pretty cool on the outside.

name: Cosmos Visor Helm
desc: A futuristic helm sealed under a big glass dome, leaving the view open to marvel at the miracles of space.

name: Iron Breastplate
desc: Charge into battle with this epic chest piece.

name: Kelp Mantle
desc: An upper body armor made from long kelp strands. Now you feel like a real creature of the sea.

name: Omoroth's Chestplate
desc: A upper body armor reminiscent of the Sea Titan. There is a sleek cape attached to it.

name: Gingerbread Top
desc: A tasty breast armor made from gingerbread, comes with sugar buttons and a fondant bowtie.

name: Stone Chestplate
desc: A cumbersome but sturdy armor piece of finely chiselled stone.

name: Hydra Bone Breastplate
desc: The nearly indestructible rib bones of a hydra; they adjust to the chest size of the wearer.

name: Desert Guardian Tunic
desc: A light tunic over a dark, full-body layer underneath. Fitted with golden jewelry.

name: Wood Pants
desc: The next best thing when it comes to lower body armor.

name: Bronze Pants
desc: Some bronze for the shin.

name: Dreamer Shalvar
desc: Baggy shalvar pants under a jade sarong-like cloth that almost floats as you move.

name: Octarine Pants
desc: This peculiar leg protection phases energy through your whole body.

name: Scuba Fins
desc: Squeaky footwear made from a rubber-like material. It's uncomfortably wet.

name: Omoroth's Leg Armor
desc: Delicately decorated leg protection that's constantly wet. Looks cool but is very uncomfortable to wear.

name: Scarab Legs
desc: A lower body armor mimicking the properties of desert critters.

name: Gingerbread Pants
desc: Fairly stiff legs are the main feature of this baked armor, as well as crumbs between the toes.

name: Wildwarden Pants
desc: Leafy legwear made from ancient wooden roots that seem to connect with the earth whenever one stands still.

name: Hydra Bone Shins
desc: An extremely sturdy lower body armor reinforced with hydra bone plates.

name: Void-Fused Leggings
desc: A pair of rusty sheets coiled around sleek dark purplish leggings.

name: Godsent King Pants Armor
desc: A unique, royal piece of armor resembling the heir of the state, which was supposed to carry the glory of the kingdom when inheriting the throne. A dark prophecy and act of assassination ended the royal line.

name: Ranger Pants
desc: These sturdy leather pants tighten your stance and grant you steady aim for your target.

name: Core Commander Greaves
desc: Woven from otherworldly cloth in confusing patterns, this armor piece escapes any understanding of earthly craftsmanship.

name: Galaxite Pants
desc: A futuristic armor for the lower body. It makes you feel like every small step you take is a giant leap for mankind.

name: Sentry Helm
desc: The detached head of a core sentry. Wearing it feels incredibly clunky and heavy but it makes up for it with great protection.

name: Adventurer's Hat
desc: Looks familiar.

name: Wildwarden Mask
desc: A wooden mask with decorative leaves and horns attuned to the wildlife.

name: Shrooman Cap
desc: It grows on your head. You can feel your wounds growing shut along with it.

name: Welder Helmet
desc: A heat-resistant metal headpiece that protects the wearer from hazardous particles.

name: Iron Helm
desc: Tough helm fit for knights. Comes with a visor and a flamboyant plume.

name: Diving Helm
desc: This heavy chunk of metal was used to explore deep waters, unfortunately it's leaking now. Still works as a nice armor piece.

name: Slime Helm
desc: A gooey, constantly dripping helm that covers half of your face.

name: Omoroth's Helm
desc: An iron-cast helm with a scary grimace and potruding tentacles.

name: Galaxite Helm
desc: A futuristic helmet fit for a space explorer. Looking through its visor is like looking into the depths of the universe.

name: Scarab Visor
desc: A helm made in the design of Ra-Akar, casting its central eye on your enemies.

name: Ranger Hood
desc: A dark hood of old cloth. Hardly anything but eyes set on your target peep through.

name: Hivebone Helm
desc: A helm crowned with erratic fangs and thorns akin to those on the Hive Mother maw.

name: Plague Mask
desc: An eerie beaked mask. Its inside reeks of rancid death, yet lets you live to smell it.

name: Hazmat Helm
desc: Need to handle strange materials that emit even stranger radiation? Ask no more!

name: Shadow Helmet
desc: A headgear that makes your mind feel void of emotion.

name: Assassin Cloak
desc: This multi-layered piece of fabric is tightly woven to keep the body cool and protect from coarse, grainy sand.

name: Carapace Helm
desc: A chitin-plated head piece, wearing it fills you with the urge to dig paths through the darkness.

name: Larva Helm
desc: No need for fancy hats. Just grub.

name: Miner's Protective Helm
desc: A handy helm with integrated goggles and a still functioning headlamp.

name: Festive Hat
desc: A warm, soft hat to keep ones ears warm in the cold season. You can't get around wearing one of those in winter.

name: Gingerbread Hood
desc: This gingerbread headpiece has not been baked, so it remains flexible to be drawn over the head.

name: Moldweb Helm
desc: A head-piece covered in living mold. Its pulse enhances your bodily functions.

name: Solarite Barbute
desc: A nearly indestructible helm forged with patience and precision. When it is worn, you feel energized, lively and protected.

name: Core Commander Helm
desc: The discarded headpiece of a high-rank armor. When worn, you can feel an immense power surging through your mind. It's whispering words you could never understand.

name: Sulfossil Helmet
desc: Like a crown, when worn, you assert yourself dominant over the forces within this sulfuric mass.

name: Void-Fused Helmet
desc: A helmet brimming with dark pressure. You feel it could burst from the slightest crack.

name: Wood Helm
desc: Slight protection for the head but you should look for better options soon.

name: Octarine Helm
desc: A strange headgear with no visor. For some reason you can still see clearly when putting it on.

name: King Slime Crown
desc: A rare headpiece that crowns you as king of all slimes. You feel very royal wearing it.

name: Godsent King Mask
desc: A unique, royal piece of armor resembling the head of the state, crowning it as a descendant of the gods. It was intended for a future that never came.

name: Atlantean Worm Helmet
desc: A fierce looking helm that resembles the head of the Atlantean Worm. How it came to be is a mystery.

name: Hydra Bone Helm
desc: The gruesome-looking empty skull of a hydra. One senses a malevolent presence when putting it on.

name: Desert Guardian Mask
desc: A mysterious headpiece that resembles some sort of animal.

name: Dreamer Headband
desc: A jade headband with hypnotically swaying fringes.

name: Inventor Goggles
desc: Goggles saturated with a maniacal green from one too many experimental mishaps.

name: Copper Helm
desc: Resembles more of a bucket but repels strong blows to the head.

name: Bronze Helm
desc: This helm repels slight blows to the head.

name: Scarlet Helm
desc: Menacing-looking horned helm, fits perfectly with the rest of the set.

name: Skirmisher Cap
desc: A headpiece worn by caveling skirmishers which has been cobbled together with larvaskin, leaves and dirty cloth.

name: Gingerbreadman Head
desc: A funny headpiece made from gingerbread. Just ignore the creepy smile and soulless eyes.

name: Shaman Skull
desc: A skull covered in ritualistic markings. Its burning eye sockets ignite a fiery fury in you.

name: Blast Helmet
desc: A heavy capsule that would be airtight if not for the narrow slits of its faceplate.

name: Ninja Garments
desc: Moving swiftly as the wind.

name: Rubber Boots
desc: Smooth slime-proof boots that keep your feet dry and agile. Also great for jumping into puddles.

name: Ninja Cowl
desc: Hidden by the dark.

name: Rain Coat
desc: Sticky things slide right off from this glossy elastic coat. The bright yellow is just a nice touch.

name: Ninja Leggings
desc: Gone without a sound.

name: Assassin Hood
desc: A mysterious hood for true desert dwellers that keeps the face in shade.

name: Witch Doctor Vest
desc: A worn vest with a simple shirt underneath.

name: Witch Doctor Jeans
desc: A pair of jeans with a golden chain strapped on.

name: Gemstone Garment
desc: This noble robe covers the body in a cascading, silk-like fabric. The woven in ancient gemstone enhance spiritual capabilities.

name: Gemstone Harem Pants
desc: A set of pants that feels very comfortable to wear. Rooting you in the here and now, you can feel your mental focus increasing.

name: Witch Doctor Hat
desc: A rustic top hat with various trinkets along the brim.

name: Makeshift Goggles
desc: Monocular night vision made from various scientific gadgetry.

name: Researcher's Coat
desc: A specialized lab coat faintly tinged with radiation. It's probably harmless.

name: Researcher's Pants
desc: A pair of pale leggings designed to idle on office chairs, yet perfectly fit for outrunning extradimensional horrors.

name: Peasant Hat
desc: Simple leather hat, doesn't look that great but does its job.

name: Caveling Hood
desc: Light armor hood that hides the face.

name: Hunter Hood
desc: This hood is made from big leaves tucked into a headband. Lets you blend into green environments.

name: Farmer's Hat
desc: Tuck a straw in your mouth and get ready for a whole day of relaxing on the porch.

name: Radical Rabbit Ears
desc: A cute hood featuring white rabbit ears. You feel quite cheeky and swift wearing it.

name: Scholar's Hood
desc: A strange hood made from white linen and gold, in its shade you feel more intelligent than usual.

name: Sunglasses
desc: Nothing is more important than sporting cool sunglasses, even when it's dark.

name: Spooky Blanket Hood
desc: A cheap last-minute attempt to get ready for the spooky season.

name: Flower Crown
desc: A beautiful crown made from leaves and pink roses. It resembles a love that feels like eternal spring.

name: Top Hat
desc: This hat is worn by everyone who considers themself an admirable adventurer equipped with a captivating charisma.

name: Explorer's Hat
desc: A hat that's made to go adventuring. Never falls off, even when a giant boulder is chasing behind.

name: Chef's Hat
desc: The hallmark of every professional cook. Proof that even in the undergrounds taste can have priority over nutrition.

name: Radical Rabbit Headband
desc: A cute headband featuring white rabbit ears. You feel quite cheeky and swift wearing it.

name: Mercenary Headband
desc: The only thing you need to put on when you want to rush through the jungle as a one-man-army…wait, that was something else.

name: Corrupt Warden Mask
desc: A wooden mask with decorative beads and a distant stare.

name: Grim Hood
desc: This opposing hood is sure to strike fear into your opponents.

name: Apprentice Hat
desc: A humble wizard's hat.

name: Sorcerer Hood
desc: A hood worn by Initiated mages.

name: Arcane Monk Blindfold
desc: The magic energies around you let you see just as clearly as with your eyes.

name: Pandorium Helm
desc: Glistening and twisted. When worn, you feel attuned to all possible outcomes.

name: Chieftain Headdress
desc: This grand headdress shows clearly who's boss.

name: Soaring Headgear
desc: A stylish hat and scarf, fit for one another.

name: Tassel Earrings
desc: A pair of earrings, each with an elegant tassel decoration.

name: Lily Pad Hat
desc: This lily pad appears unusually sturdy. It fits on your head nicely.

name: Pajama Cap
desc: A blue soft nightcap.

name: Scarf
desc: A warm neckcloth for colder seasons.

name: Bandana
desc: A rag fit for a suspenseful ruffian.

name: Peasant Chest
desc: A simple makeshift armor for the upper body.

name: Caveling Chest
desc: Made from grub leather, good for unhindered movement in combat.

name: Hunter Cloak
desc: A cloak crafted from big leaves woven together. Makes you look like a walking bush.

name: Ivy's Thorn Harness
desc: This organic breastplate armor is crested with thorns, allowing for stronger critical hits.

name: Scholar's Cloak
desc: A magically-imbued piece of cloth, worn by caveling scholars. Wearing it you feel in tune with the ancients.

name: Towel
desc: A towel is about the most massively useful thing an underground miner can have.

name: Green Bikini Top
desc: A green swim suit piece that keeps everything in its place. Everyone knows the most revealing armor is the most protective.

name: Blue Bikini Top
desc: A blue swim suit piece that keeps everything in its place. Everyone knows the most revealing armor is the most protective.

name: Red Bikini Top
desc: A red swim suit piece that keeps everything in its place. Everyone knows the most revealing armor is the most protective.

name: Miner's Labor Suit
desc: An airtight zip-up suit for working in deep caverns. The flashy orange makes it official.

name: Spooky Blanket Cape
desc: Boohooo, behold the dirty bedding!

name: Cupid Tunic
desc: When wearing this tunic, one feels as if they have been sent from the heavens to spread love.

name: Wedding Dress
desc: A simple, white dress elevating the beauty of its wearer. There are many occasions to wear it but the most important one is being a bride.

name: Suit Jacket
desc: The elegant jacket has a stuck-on rose and is perfect for a romantic dinner. Remember to show up on time.

name: Explorer's Jacket
desc: A leather jacket that's almost too warm to wear on adventures, but it looks cool!

name: Chef's Jacket
desc: It's just a spotless, white jacket but the red neckerchief makes it official. Time to get cookin'!

name: Trenchcoat
desc: A coat with deep pockets fit for a hoggish, dodgy fancier.

name: Mercenary Tank Top
desc: Green and full of sweat this piece of clothing is perfect for emerging from the shadows guns blazing.

name: Corrupt Warden Tunic
desc: A simple tunic but with jewelry and fine fabrics layered on top.

name: Grim Breastplate
desc: A grand, ominous robe with sharp shoulder pads.

name: Apprentice Robe
desc: A plain robe worn by mages in training.

name: Sorcerer Robe
desc: A robust robe, using magic fused into the fabric to withstand attacks.

name: Arcane Monk Cloak
desc: A cloak with particular magical patterns woven in.

name: Pandorium Chestplate and Bracers
desc: These plates feel inexplicably connected to your entire nervous system. When worn, your muscles twitch with anticipation.

name: Chieftain Tunic
desc: Made with some of the finest Bambuck wool.

name: Soaring Poncho
desc: Comfy and lightweight, this poncho flows well as you run.

name: Tassel Top
desc: A top featuring tassels along the bottom.

name: Lily Pad Tunic
desc: A light shirt with a lily pad strapped over. A little flower is keeping it tied in place.

name: Pajama Shirt
desc: A blue cozy nightshirt.

name: Caveling Pants
desc: These pants don't cover much but make your movement more elusive.

name: Ivy's Pants
desc: Lower body armor naturally grown in the underground jungle, featuring thorned kneecaps.

name: Green Board Shorts
desc: Wearing those chill green shorts tempts you to constantly form the shaka sign with your hand.

name: Blue Board Shorts
desc: Wearing those chill blue shorts tempts you to constantly form the shaka sign with your hand.

name: Red Board Shorts
desc: Wearing those chill red shorts tempts you to constantly form the shaka sign with your hand.

name: Green Bikini Bottom
desc: A green underwear piece that goes well with its top part. Get rid of unnecessary clothing and run free in the sun!

name: Blue Bikini Bottom
desc: A blue underwear piece that goes well with its top part. Get rid of unnecessary clothing and run free in the sun!

name: Red Bikini Bottom
desc: A red underwear piece that goes well with its top part. Get rid of unnecessary clothing and run free in the sun!

name: Miner's Worker Pants
desc: Well-fitting pants that make traversing the underground much more convenient. Comes with squeaky rubber boots.

name: Suit Pants
desc: These pants are made from black, silky fabric and hint at sophistication and confidence.

name: Explorer's Pants
desc: A good pair of pants that is made for traveling long distances and sneaking past ancient traps.

name: Chef's Pants
desc: Sporting an apron, these pants are made to prove their worth in the steam and heat of a cave kitchen.

name: Mercenary Pants
desc: Camouflaged leggings that keep you on your toes around heavily-guarded areas.

name: Corrupt Warden Shorts
desc: A pair of shorts, decorated with various bands and jewelry.

name: Grim Legwear
desc: Despite the sturdy, skeletal frame, you can still move with ease.

name: Apprentice Pants
desc: Comfortable and breezy pants that aid in focus.

name: Sorcerer Pants
desc: Sturdy pants with plenty of pockets for magical trinkets.

name: Arcane Monk Leggings
desc: Both sturdy and light, these pants won't get in the way while casting spells.

name: Pandorium Pants
desc: Light and breathable leg armor. When worn, you can sense the smallest tremors beneath your feet.

name: Chieftain Shorts
desc: Fine shorts with plenty of jewelry, well suited for a leader.

name: Soaring Pants
desc: Comes equipped with winged boots that should aid your mobility.

name: Tassel Skirt
desc: A fine skirt with multiple decorative tassels.

name: Lily Pad Shorts
desc: A light pair of shorts with a lily pad strapped around the hip.

name: Pajama Pants
desc: A pair of blue comfortable nightpants.

name: Chicken Hat
desc: A derpy-looking chicken hat that will be center of attention at the next party. Clucking funny!

name: Chicken Breast Piece
desc: Itchy feathers and a concerning lack of ventilation make this chicken body piece a bold choice of clothing.

name: Chicken Pants
desc: These flashy pants are chicken skin-inducing and complete the look of an egg-citing easter costume.

name: Eggcellent Hat
desc: Everyone wearing this oversized egg shell hat has only one mission: to become egg.

name: Eggcellent Breast Piece
desc: A spacious, oval shape that is made from hopes, dreams and lime. In other words: Egg.

name: Eggcellent Pants
desc: These cheaply made pants are as yellow as egg yolk and itchy beyond comprehension.

name: Green Party Hat
desc: This groovy green party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

name: Red Party Hat
desc: This radical red party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

name: Blue Party Hat
desc: This blazing blue party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

name: Purple Party Hat
desc: This perky purple party hat can be worn to celebrate a special anniversary.

name: Dragon Mask
desc: An intimidating but well-meaning mask that invokes the spirit of mythological dragons.

name: Make-A-Wish Hat
desc: A glimmering party hat for a generous heart. The caves feel a little less dark, and the world a little less gloomy thanks to your charity.

name: The Mad Hat
desc: A once-ordinary hat now stuffed with scribbled notes, maps, and theories about the underground. Listen closely, and it might just share a helpful hint or two.
